method.guess_3_rule: Count your hits to find the candidate pool, then play the word that leaves the fewest expected candidates: a candidate if that word is still possible, otherwise a split word that reuses a hit letter or a burn word that carries no hit letter.
method.continuation: After guess 3 the same expected-candidates-minimising rule is applied each turn, excluding words already played.
method.guess_universe: data/answers.txt (2,309 words), the same pool hit_tree.py scores; data/allowed.txt was not used.
method.substitutions: None: no stronger solver or candidate-only policy was substituted. Later guesses reuse the guess-3 rule rather than playing an exact optimal policy.
